answer: Sybil resistance follows from combining EigenTrust-style trust propagation with temporal decay: reputation loses half its weight over each fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honest service to retain influence. Fresh identities named cipher, falcon, or violet begin with negligible eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits the benefit of mutual endorsements, preventing them from quickly gaining consensus power.
